# Engagements (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Client engagements: list, create (with the wizard's starting points), update, archive, export and delete; the KPI and Overview numbers.

## Files

- `archive.ts`: Archiving makes an engagement read-only: records stay, nothing changes.
- `create-engagement.ts`: Creating an engagement (POST /engagements): the record, its first member and agents, and the optional starting points chosen in the Add engagement wizard (a Statement of Applicability, use cases, client tools and a draft client workflow).
- `engagement-routes.ts`: Engagements: list, create (with the optional client workflow and tools) and update.
- `kpis.ts`: The numbers behind the KPI tiles at the top of each page (v1.7).
- `overview-routes.ts`: The numbers behind the KPI tiles, the Overview page and the activity charts.
